sections.text:
Marriott International Residences
Welcome Home
Rooted in hospitality, Marriott Residences offer the kinds of thoughtful, innovative amenities that cater to your elevated lifestyle. In collaboration with DarGlobal, a new kind of home was crafted, one that ensures owners wake up every day to the same wonderful experiences that they have come to expect from Marriott Hotels, and truly understands the wants and needs of the discerning few who enjoy luxury living.
Discover More
Pagani
Living The Dream
Horacio Pagani always dreamed of creating the most beautiful car in the world. Not only did he succeed, but also, he created a whole new dimension in the automotive field, a dimension only the few can aspire to After years of perfecting his automotive masterpiece, Horacio Pagani partnered with DarGlobal to pay tribute to his muse, Leonardo DaVinci, by blending beauty and function to give life to the first residences in the world with interiors by Pagani.
Missoni
“ To furnish my own way is to create an organized but informal habitat that excites and intrigues, where every space is an oasis of colors and moods.” – Rosita Missoni, founder of Missoni. After designing the iconic Missoni Baia in Miami, Florida, Missoni partnered with DarGlobal to, for the second time ever, export its distinct living concept to Dubai. An iconic residential tower in Dubai decorated with a range of exquisite home accessories and colorful settings, presenting Missoni’s take on elite ‘Miami lifestyle’ homes on par with luxury and fashion.
W Hotels
A vibrant Lifestyle
Born out of the bold attitude and 24/7 culture of New York City, W Hotels has defied expectations, broken down all the norms of traditional luxury, and taken it to the next level. They partnered with DarGlobal to design its ultra-exquisite W Residences Dubai – Downtown, situated in the beating heart of Dubai’s vibrant life.
Elie Saab
Haute Couture Living
ELIE SAAB founded his eponymous label in 1982, at just 18 years old. Since then, the ELIE SAAB house has been established as one of the major leaders in the HAUTE COUTURE category globally, with ateliers based in Paris, London and Beirut. He partnered with DarGlobal to create Qatar’s ﬁrst ever co-branded residences on Qetaifan Island North.
Dolce and Gabbana
The Allure of Italian Fashion
Dolce&Gabbana is an Italian luxury fashion house founded in 1985 by Italian designers Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana. The house quickly overtook the world with its avantgarde designs in haute Couture, ready-to-wear, handbags, accessories, cosmetics and furnishings. In partnership with DarGlobal, this Italian allure will come to life in one of the most beautiful places in the world, the Maldives. The partnership’s debut project is set to be a game-changer in the luxury hospitality industry, combining Dolce&Gabbana’s unparalleled sense of style with DarGlobal’s unrivalled attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
Trump Organization
Setting the Standards of Excellence
In New York City and around the world, the Trump signature is synonymous with the most prestigious of addresses. In collaboration with DarGlobal, the Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course will be developed on the hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman.
trump
Lamborghini
A legendary Collaboration
A legendary collaboration between Dar Al Arkan and the super automaker of the world, Lamborghini. Together they will build a revolutionary residential project in one of the most premier locations in the world.
Aston Martin
A New Era of Elegance
DarGlobal and Aston Martin unite to redefine luxury living with a groundbreaking residential development. This prestigious collaboration marks the first time Aston Martin ventures into the GCC, bringing its iconic elegance and cutting-edge innovation to the region. Known for their exquisite craftsmanship and timeless design, Aston Martin's involvement ensures a living experience that epitomizes sophistication and luxury. By combining their automotive heritage with architectural prowess, this partnership promises to deliver unparalleled excellence in a prime location, setting a new standard for luxury living.
MOUAWAD
Let It Rain Diamonds
Mouawad, a renowned luxury jewelry brand, is celebrated for its timeless elegance, craftsmanship, and rich heritage. With over a century of excellence, it captivates discerning clients worldwide with its exquisite creations and iconic world records. Founded in Lebanon in 1890, Mouawad continues to offer true luxury and refinement, guided by five generations of visionary leadership.

sections.heading: What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
sections.text:
Q: What's ROI, ROE and ROL?
A: ROI (Return on Investment): measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation.
ROE (Return on Ego): the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for.
ROL (Return on Legacy): the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow.
We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure.
Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride.
With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.

Frequently Asked Questions - The Astera by Aston Martin
Who developed The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
The Astera is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Aston Martin, marking the British marque's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council).
Where is The Astera located?
The Astera sits on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, near the Wynn Resort with direct beachfront access, about an hour's drive from Dubai.
What types of residences are available at The Astera?
The development offers one, two and three-bedroom apartments alongside three-bedroom villas, each finished with Aston Martin's signature interior design.
Is this Aston Martin's first real estate project in the Middle East?
Yes. The Astera marks Aston Martin's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council), following earlier design partnerships in the United States and Japan.
What is the value of The Astera development?
The Astera carries a Gross Development Value of approximately AED 900 million, around £200 million.
When is The Astera expected to be completed?
Construction is underway following the appointment of Stromek Emirates Foundations for shoring, excavation and piling works, with completion due by December 2028.
What amenities does The Astera offer?
Residents have access to a private beach, an infinity pool with ocean views, a scenic walking track, an indoor cinema, a fitness centre, a spa, a yoga lawn, a children's play area and a multipurpose hall.
What makes the Aston Martin interiors distinct?
Aston Martin's design team applies the marque's signature blend of sophistication, precision craftsmanship and high-performance design language to every residence's interior.
How far is The Astera from Dubai?
Dubai is approximately an hour's drive from Al Marjan Island, keeping The Astera close to the city while offering a secluded beachfront setting.
Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing at The Astera?
Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa, and the UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

Frequently Asked Questions - The Trump Organization
What projects has DarGlobal developed with The Trump Organization?
DarGlobal's collaborations with The Trump Organization include AIDA in Muscat, Oman (hotel, golf villas and cliff villas),
Trump Tower Jeddah
in Saudi Arabia, and
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai
Where is AIDA located?
AIDA sits on a hilltop over 100 metres above sea level, about 10 minutes from Downtown Muscat, Oman.
What is the value of Trump International Oman at AIDA?
Trump International Oman
is a USD 500 million, 140-key, 5-star hotel complex within AIDA.
What amenities does AIDA offer?
AIDA features private beach access, an 18-hole championship golf course, a members-only club and the Cliff Hanging Night Club, alongside hanging suites and villas.
When is Trump International Oman at AIDA expected to open?
The hotel is scheduled to open in December 2028, with AIDA's first phase completing in 2027.
Where is Trump Tower Jeddah located?
stands on Jeddah's Corniche, rising 47 floors as one of the city's tallest residential towers.
What is the value of Trump Tower Jeddah?
Trump Tower Jeddah is valued at SAR 2 billion, approximately USD 531 million.
What is the Trump Club?
The Trump Club is Saudi Arabia's first-ever members-only social club, housed within Trump Tower Jeddah and offering privacy, luxury and curated experiences.
How long have DarGlobal and The Trump Organization been collaborating?
The partnership spans more than a decade, covering AIDA,
and
What makes these developments distinct?
Each pairs The Trump Organization's global luxury hospitality standard with DarGlobal's premium locations across Oman, Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

Frequently Asked Questions - W Residences
Who developed W Residences Dubai – Downtown?
W Residences Dubai
– Downtown is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with W Hotels, with residence management by Marriott International.
Where is W Residences Dubai – Downtown located?
The residences sit in Downtown Dubai, with views of Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Fountain, Dubai Opera and Old Town Dubai.
How many residences does the tower include?
The tower comprises 384 exclusive residences.
What is the value of W Residences Dubai – Downtown?
The development was valued at AED 1 billion at launch, with main construction works later awarded for AED 273 million.
When is W Residences Dubai – Downtown expected to complete?
Completion was originally estimated for September 2026. Please verify with the sales team for the final building handover and move-in schedule.
Is this the first standalone W-branded residential project in the world?
Yes,
– Downtown marks the first standalone residences globally under the W Hotels brand, developed by
DarGlobal
What amenities does W Residences offer?
Residents have access to the FUEL wellness concept, an infinity pool overlooking Burj Khalifa, the FIT Fitness Centre, a spa, a media room with cinema, a coworking space and a clubhouse.
What is the Whatever/Whenever service?
Whatever/Whenever is W Hotels' signature concierge service, offering round-the-clock in-residence dining, housekeeping, laundry and lifestyle assistance.
How far is W Residences from key Dubai landmarks?
The residences are about 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 10 minutes from DIFC, and minutes from The Dubai Mall.
Are units still available at W Residences Dubai – Downtown?
The development has previously been reported as sold out; buyers interested in resale opportunities should check current availability with DarGlobal directly.
